packages.area: Android ViewModel/MainActivity/widget: routes, limits, backup, widget security, startup

items.text: Station canonicalizer indexes are built twice on the Main thread at catalog load, roughly doubling startup main-thread index work — `app/TrainViewModel.kt`
items.fix_summary: The station indexes for the curated catalog are built off the main thread, so cold start no longer stalls the interactive planner.

items.text: Saved routes, recents and favourites referencing a custom station that the catalog canonicalizes are dropped and later deleted permanently — `app/TrainViewModel.kt`
items.fix_summary: Saved routes, recents, favourites and monitors that point at a custom station the catalog now covers are moved to the catalog station instead of being dropped and deleted.

items.text: Backup import replaces all routes, favourites, monitors, alerts and preferences immediately, without preview, confirmation or undo — `app/MainActivity.kt`
items.fix_summary: Choosing a backup first shows what it contains and that it will replace the current local data; nothing changes until the user confirms.

items.text: Pinning/unpinning any saved route while a searched (ad-hoc) or widget route is active switches the app to 'no route selected' while still showing the old departures — `app/TrainViewModel.kt`
items.fix_summary: Pinning or unpinning a saved route keeps the current searched or widget route active.

items.text: Widget refresh is gated on network even for routes served entirely by embedded offline GTFS: new widgets and direction toggles stay 'data unavailable' offline — `app/widget/RouteWidgetProvider.kt`
items.fix_summary: User-initiated widget refreshes (configure, direction tap, refresh button) run offline and are answered from the embedded timetables, while periodic background refreshes keep their network constraint.

items.text: Stop-alarm confirmation persists for the whole session and is shown on every other train's detail screen — `app/MainActivity.kt`
items.fix_summary: The stop-alarm confirmation appears only on the detail screen of the train it was set for.

items.text: Creating a route when 32 routes exist silently deletes the last existing route — `app/data/SavedRouteOrdering.kt`
items.fix_summary: Creating a route at the 32-route limit is refused with a message instead of silently deleting an existing route.

items.text: Android: v0.16.3 backups import the preset route 'default-roma-torino' as a success, which RouteStore then silently drops on the next launch — `app/LocalDataBackup.kt`
items.fix_summary: Backups from v0.16.3 no longer import the retired Roma–Torino preset as a route that then disappears on the next launch; import counts match what is kept.

items.text: Android: exported MainActivity trusts EXTRA_APPWIDGET_ID from any caller and persists the corresponding route as active — `app/MainActivity.kt`
items.fix_summary: Only taps on the app's own widgets can switch and persist the active route; another app sending a widget id to MainActivity no longer can.

items.text: Native launcher shortcuts use implicit intents on an unverified custom scheme (no targetPackage/targetClass), so other apps can intercept them — `app/src/main/res/xml/shortcuts.xml`
items.fix_summary: Launcher shortcuts always open Binario's own MainActivity (explicit targetPackage/targetClass) and can no longer be intercepted by another app registering the binario:// scheme.

items.text: Android: opening the app from a widget persists a synthetic active-route id ('route:<o>:<d>') that RouteStore can never resolve; next cold start opens another route and pinning resets to no route — `app/widget/WidgetConfigureActivity.kt`
items.fix_summary: Opening the app from a widget activates the matching saved route when one exists, and no longer persists an id that the next cold start cannot resolve.

items.text: Picking a station by name still resolves to the first catalog match: 122 stations cannot be selected; some map silently to another town and are saved that way — `app/data/StationAutocompleteEngine.kt`
items.fix_summary: The station the user taps in a suggestion list is the one saved and searched, even when another station has the same name.

items.text: M-6 regression guard is textual: re-introducing the original watch false success (show 'Checklist aperta sul telefono' as soon as the request is sent) keeps all 25 native-surface contract tests green — `companion-expo/tests/native-surface-contract.test.ts`
items.fix_summary: Restoring a backup waits for the station catalogue to load, so old backups are no longer rejected or imported in part after the app was killed while the catalogue was loading.

items.text: PR#34 removed the 'pending export missing' feedback, so a second Agenda export result leaves a 0-byte file silently — `app/MainActivity.kt`
items.fix_summary: A double tap on Esporta JSON/ICS opens only one picker; any orphan result is reported as a failure and its empty file deleted.

items.text: Android instrumented Compose accessibility tests are never compiled or run by CI and assert Italian strings without pinning a locale — `app/MainScreenAccessibilityTest.kt`
items.fix_summary: CI compiles the instrumented accessibility tests, and those tests take their expected text from string resources, so they hold in any device language (static only: no SDK).

packages.area: Android phone app Play readiness (settings, privacy link, icons, widget metadata, alarms, locales)

items.text: Google Play blocker: no public privacy-policy URL and no in-app privacy link; PRIVACY.md declares controller/contact/URL missing; settings_privacy_wear string says 'non esiste ancora un link pubblico nell'app'.
items.fix_summary: Read gradle property BINARIO_PRIVACY_POLICY_URL (default empty) into BuildConfig.PRIVACY_POLICY_URL; in the Settings privacy section add an 'Informativa privacy' action row (5 locales) that opens the URL with ACTION_VIEW inside runCatching, hidden when empty; replace the 'non esiste ancora un link pubblico' sentence in all 5 locales with neutral wording; make tools/verify_android_release_config.py require an https URL when a RELEASE gate env is set (document it in android-ci.yml); add a 'Titolare del trattamento e contatto' section with explicit placeholders to PRIVACY.md.

items.text: Placeholder 'Apple Watch' and 'Comandi vocali e Alexa' toggles in Settings do nothing and say so (Play 'broken functionality' exposure).
items.fix_summary: Gate the Alexa and Apple Watch IntegrationChoice rows and integration_alexa_note behind BuildConfig.EXPERIMENTAL_INTEGRATIONS fed by gradle property BINARIO_EXPERIMENTAL_INTEGRATIONS (default false); keep IntegrationSettings keys and UnifiedProfile fields for forward compatibility; add a unit test for the setting default.

items.text: Home-screen widget has no preview metadata and its configuration activity lacks the APPWIDGET_CONFIGURE intent filter / export.
items.fix_summary: route_widget_info.xml: add previewLayout=@layout/route_widget, targetCellWidth/Height (3x2), minResizeWidth/Height, widgetFeatures=reconfigurable (keep API 26 compatibility: previewLayout/targetCell attrs are ignored below 31, previewImage optional); AndroidManifest: give WidgetConfigureActivity the android.appwidget.action.APPWIDGET_CONFIGURE intent-filter with exported=true as the platform requires, keeping it safe (no extras trusted beyond the widget id).

items.text: Launcher icon is a plain opaque vector reused as the notification small icon (renders as a white square); no adaptive icon.
items.fix_summary: Add mipmap-anydpi-v26/ic_launcher.xml and ic_launcher_round.xml (<adaptive-icon> with background colour #005A52 drawable, foreground = the train glyph scaled into the 66/108 safe zone, monochrome layer); point manifest icon/roundIcon to @mipmap/ic_launcher; add a dedicated white-on-transparent notification small icon drawable ic_stat_binario and use it for every notification (stop alarm, commuter alert, checklist); keep legacy mipmap PNG fallbacks only if required by minSdk 26 (adaptive icons exist since 26, so none needed).

items.text: No localeFilters/resourceConfigurations: all library locales are packaged although localeConfig lists five; Jetifier enabled without need.
items.fix_summary: In app/ and wear/ build.gradle.kts add androidResources { localeFilters += listOf("it","en","de","fr","es") }; remove android.enableJetifier=true from gradle.properties (keep useAndroidX); mention the filter in tools/verify_android_release_config.py and its test.

items.text: SCHEDULE_EXACT_ALARM is declared but never requested: on Android 14+ every stop alarm and commuter alert is inexact and the UI offers no path to grant it (R4:M-3).
items.fix_summary: When !alarmManager.canScheduleExactAlarms() show an action (settings and the alarm creation flows) that launches Settings.ACTION_REQUEST_SCHEDULE_EXACT_ALARM with the package URI; re-arm alarms on AlarmManager.ACTION_SCHEDULE_EXACT_ALARM_PERMISSION_STATE_CHANGED via a receiver; strings in 5 locales; unit-test the decision logic (JVM-testable helper).

items.text: Community mirror jbb.ghsq.de contacted by the store build is not disclosed in the in-app privacy text (R4:M-14).
items.fix_summary: Add the European Sleeper/JBB community-mirror sentence to the in-app privacy strings in all five locales, consistent with PRIVACY.md and tools/verify_privacy_policy.py.

items.text: Wear UI and Tile use phone-style layouts with no round-screen handling (Wear OS review criterion).
items.fix_summary: WearMainActivity: wrap content in Wear Compose Material3 AppScaffold/ScreenScaffold with TimeText and a scroll indicator; use TransformingLazyColumn (or ScalingLazyColumn with responsive content padding) so first/last items are not clipped on round screens; Tile: use primaryLayout with the ProtoLayout material responsive helpers; keep accessibility labels; the wear unit tests must stay green and the module must compile in android-check.sh wear (if the harness cannot compile Wear Compose, say so and keep changes minimal and static-reviewed).
files: gradle/verification-metadata.xml (only if a new artifact is unavoidable; prefer existing dependencies)

items.text: First-run path on the watch cannot succeed without an undocumented phone setting and gives no feedback when the phone app is absent.
items.fix_summary: Reword empty_snapshot_message in wear/src/main/res/values{,-en,-de,-es,-fr}/strings.xml to say sharing must be enabled in the phone app's settings ('Smartwatch Android'), keeping key parity (WearStringResourceParityTest); declare a phone capability in app/src/main/res/values/wear.xml (android_wear_capabilities) so the watch can detect the phone app via CapabilityClient and show a specific message when absent.

items.text: Complication polls every 5 minutes although data is push-driven, and SHORT_TEXT carries a 32-char string (RD-11).
items.fix_summary: Set UPDATE_PERIOD_SECONDS to 0 (push only, request update on snapshot change); for SHORT_TEXT use the expected departure as text and the train number as title; bound validity with setValidTimeRange to the snapshot expiry.

items.text: Wear launcher icon is a square 48dp vector with opaque square background, not adaptive.
items.fix_summary: Add wear/src/main/res/mipmap-anydpi-v26/ic_launcher.xml adaptive icon (background layer + foreground glyph inset to the safe zone), point icon/roundIcon to it, keep ic_binario_wear for tile/complication service icons.

items.text: Watch Activity never re-validates the snapshot on resume, so an expired snapshot is shown until the next push (FSK-WEAR-ACTIVITY-UPTIME).
items.fix_summary: Re-read WearSnapshotStore.current(this) in onResume (or observe ON_RESUME) so the expired value is revoked before the screen is shown; unit-test the expiry decision.

items.text: PRIVACY.md 'Interrompere Wear' row contradicts the implemented watch-side revocation (WC-N7).
items.fix_summary: Align PRIVACY.md line ~116 with line ~64 (watch-side revocation is implemented).

items.text: Tile fallback layout hard-codes 'Binario' and the production tile layout is untested (RD-13).
items.fix_summary: Make the timeline builder take the layout function from the service and test the production layout through a string-provider seam; move compose-ui-tooling to debugImplementation and update the suppression test accordingly.
